text_post: The Year in Review:Coming Full Circle Hi! This is my first post, but I've been lurking on this board for a little over a year now and have been refraining from posting until I actually had something to contribute, some kind of practical earned experience out there in the real world rather than a bunch of basic questions. So here goes.. For some background, I'm 30 years old and all my life I was like many other men who find this community. A series of bad relationships with women I really didn't care for to much but because I didn't have a real idea of the psychology of seduction, which made getting options seem a far harder task than it actually is. I grew up pretty isolated as a teen, my parents were hard on me, while not abusive, they were of the variety that kids are there for free labor, school was a day care, rather than a place to learn social skills. They kept me at home most of the time, the only exception made was to work a job. I was never allowed to go to parties, never allowed to dances, or other extra curricular activities that are so very important to a young man building social skills. So naturally when I reached adult age I was ignorant of social dynamics in anything but they're most basic form. Basically my parents intentionally raised a Beta worker-bee male, whos only saw value in himself as a workaholic. While I had an occasional girlfriend, I never had the chance to build the kind of social intelligence necessary to pick up the really good looking women. I always had fat UGs for girls. I would see guys with hotties and think, why can't I have that? Try for them and always fail, so I blamed myself. Then about 4 years ago, I started selling drugs, yes I know its a bad thing I realize now, but it was good for me because it forced me to be social, I HAD to get out of my shell to be successful. I learned alot of basic social skills that I had lacked. I had beautiful girls over my house all day every day, surrounded by them. I was the king of my social circle, with all the social proof I needed(back then I didn't realize it as social proof per se). Eventually after watching all my friends go to prison I got out of that game.  But, while I was selling one particular girl caught my attention(a HB9) and we began seeing eachother, we fell in love and had a wonderful 2 year relationship. But, because I was a complete AFC still, only relying on the social proof that being a drug dealer brings with it, I did everything wrong. I was clingy, insecure, and generally AFC in all my dealings and as soon as the social proof of being a drug dealier faded away with my ending that line of work, so did her attraction for me. I was crushed, it took me several months to recover from the heart break, in the meantime I found this community, and.. since I had decent job now and time on my hands. I began going out 3-4 times a week up to the local college campus. This college is the midwest US equivelent of harvard, so I was around very very intelligent, socially aware people. The pressures were immense, especially for a 30 yr old male. Luckily I have very youthful looks, and I'm pretty cute, if scrawny(6' 150 lbs), and because I was not a complete geek because of my days as a drug dealer I was able to progress. At first it was very intimidating. My friends from my home town said I was crazy to be hanging around up on that campus. They thought I was to old, didn't have the money, the body, or anything. Remember I was raised pretty much in jerry springer trailerpark land where the women are fat, ugly and addicted to drugs. I didn't let any of them discourage me. I started at a club called Brick Street. I went every Monday, Wed and Thur night(because I worked weekend nights) and started by getting to know ALL the staff. I met the owner of the club, got to where the bartenders knew my drink on sight without having to be told, I tipped well and saw that as the first 3 or 4 weeks went by, that I was welcomed in as one of them. I also paid close attention to the attire the college kids wore, mostly it was Tommy, American Eagle, etc. Well coming from a more urban environment, I chose to emulate them in a different way. Instead of wearing striped Tommy polo shirts, I chose urban brands with urban cuts like Sean Jean, Avirex, State Property but didn't wear them in the 'thug way' I wore them with dress pants and shoes. I always matched head to toe also. I chose dark colors, Blacks and Greys. I chose different shoes. Basically I wore the same style collared polo shirts and stuff but different brands and colors. I used my unique fashion as a way to open HB's, one example of my fashion opener went like this MEtap on her shoulder to get her attention) Hi! Look I can see your busy trying to get your drink, I just wanted to take a quick minute and tell you how much I like that dress your wearing, I'm a man who appreciates fashion, so when I see someone making a bold fashion statement like that, I just have to come up and compliment them on it. My name is SM. HerSmiling wide) Well thank you, I'm glad I was the lucky girl. Me:Well that still remains to be seen. I've used this opener in various forms many times. Its almost always works. Yes its a compliment opener but I deliver it so confidently, and so sincerely that the girls usually melt right there. I then follow up with fashion talk, point out the genericness of other guys clothing and how I love to stand out in a crowd and set a trend. Because my clothes obviously are different from anyone elses in the club, completely match, are immaculately pressed instead of wrinkled, and are always the latest fashion( I pick up a new outfit at least once a week) its a big DHV. Well obviously it took me along time to get this kind of confidence. At first I was rejected ALOT. But after my first dozen approaches I was soon approaching sets most guys wouldn't dream of. I found out these college guys are simply pathetic. They are SCARED TO DEATH OF THE HOT CHICKS on campus and I used it to my advantage. For instance, the school year just started last month and I was up at the club a little early that day and saw 2 tables pushed together on the skybox with at least 12 chicks all 8-10's eathing a meal and drinking. It was so perfect that I just HAD to open them. so I approached with my usual 'Hey guys! How ya'll doing today? Havin fun?' to which they were all friendly like yah, blah blah for a second. I followed it up with 'I'm here alot, most of my friends work here but none of them said there was going to be such a large group of friendly looking people out here, and since I love to get to know new ppl, I had to come up and say hi, so whats the occasion?' Well I grabbed a nearby chair and had a seat and had the best time that night. I walked away with 3 numbers from that one set and they all said I was a great guy, blah blah blah.  Another example was I was standing with one of the floor staff and another guy he knew when 3 blonde 10's walked in wearing beautful smokin hot dresses. They got they drinks and proceeded to a table, well the floor guy was like 'Damn, them girls is smokin' I said 'come on man lets go meet em' he protested about he was on the job to which I busted on him and said your a floor guy, all you gotta do is ask em if everything is ok and to holler for you if they need anything, etc.. his other dude was terrified he said he wouldn't dare approach. I said 'come on guys, they're just girls' after a few minutes of cajolling they finally agreed to approach with me. Well I start walking the 10 feet to the table but by the time I get there I turned around I was alone! those AFC's had melted into the crowd as soon as they saw I was serious about approaching these chicks! I shrugged and opened with the universal 'hey guys! how ya'll doin tonight? havin fun?'  (this shit works, thsoe fancy patterns and opening routines are good for training wheels but dude you gotta get off the baby food, alot of college girls have read The Game or experienced those canned lines and you could embarrass yourself you use that stuff to much for to long)  I ended up having a 30 minute conversation and got to dance with the leader chick of the set, plus got her number and we had some very good times together before she had to leave cuase the school year ended, but when I was done with that set, every guy in the place was slappin me on the back askin me what I said to those girls to get them laughing so much(unbenownst to me those girls had a reputation for being ruthless, and shot down so many guys in that place that few had the balls to approach them) I shrugged and told them I was just being myself. I know this post is longer than I intended so I will finish up now, fast forward to a few weeks ago. HB9 ex girlfriend from a year ago gets ahold of me recently to cash a rebate check in my name she recieved from the utility company from the apartment we shared. We split the money and started talking again, only this time, there was no AFC. only pure ALPHA, I led her everywhere, I called her on her bull shit, crushed her shit testing, and watched her attraction grow over a week) she kept saying all the time 'your so DIFFERENT, what happened to you?' and I told her. I said I had been studying social dynamics online and in books and learned that how I had been acting during our relationship was the wrong way to go about it. She ate it up!  Needless to say this past weekend we are back together. I know guys who rail against one-itis but there are some women, who simply meet all your values and this one always did. The main thing is is that she knows there is alot of competition out there for my attention and to keep it she has to work at it and BOY DOES SHE WORK IT. LOL So, in a year I went from Chimp to Pimp, and I know that even if this new/old thing breaks down again. I have the ability to go out and get pussy anytime I need it. So I wanna extend gratitude to Mystery, and his crew, and all the guys on here for helping me BECOME THE MAN I wanted to be.  Thanks, SM
